background: type: solid color: "#F6F6F3" elements: [{"elementId":"title","elementType":"text","bounds":[56,34,848,40],"content":{"text":"导师一眼就能看出是 AI 做的 slides","fontFamily":"Microsoft YaHei","fontSize":26,"lineHeight":1.3,"color":"#1C2321","align":["left","top"],"bold":true},"role":"title"},{"elementId":"story","elementType":"text","bounds":[56,90,380,400],"content":{"text":"

组会上，用 AI 做的 slides 越来越常见。slides 本身就是数据、是一种文件格式，agent 学会做 slides 是迟早的事。

但我的导师和很多同学，一眼就能认出 AI 做的稿子。PowerPoint、Google Slides、ChatGPT、Kimi 各有各的风格，可看起来都还是 AI。

我理解的 AI 味，从这里来：

· 没有重点：每一点分量都一样

· 面面俱到，而不是有所取舍

· 底下没有一个故事

· 追求完整、稳妥，而不是想说清一件事

","fontFamily":"Microsoft YaHei","fontSize":16,"lineHeight":1.6,"color":"#3E4845","align":["left","top"]}},{"elementId":"even-head","elementType":"text","bounds":[462,90,442,22],"content":{"text":"这份介绍自己也一样","fontFamily":"Microsoft YaHei","fontSize":15,"lineHeight":1.3,"color":"#1C2321","align":["left","top"],"bold":true}},{"elementId":"prev-f","elementType":"shape","shapeName":"rect","bounds":[461,119,238,212],"fill":{"type":"solid","color":"#FFFFFF"},"border":{"width":1,"color":"#CBD3CF"}},{"elementId":"prev","elementType":"image","bounds":[462,120,236,210],"src":"media/.huandeng-versions/999b519e23de475d7b6d3773ba51dab3d658e27d9274e1b6942141af20b50468.png","sourceName":"claude-en-20261110-overview.png","fit":{"mode":"contain"}},{"elementId":"quote-bar","elementType":"shape","shapeName":"rect","bounds":[718,124,3,150],"fill":{"type":"solid","color":"#B9783F"}},{"elementId":"quote","elementType":"text","bounds":[732,120,172,160],"content":{"text":"“美术效果很好，但重点都不太对……其实就是没有什么重点，因为没有故事。”","fontFamily":"Microsoft YaHei","fontSize":15,"lineHeight":1.6,"color":"#1C2321","align":["left","top"]}},{"elementId":"quote-src","elementType":"text","bounds":[732,286,172,40],"content":{"text":"作者对上一版的评价，2026-11-11","fontFamily":"Microsoft YaHei","fontSize":11,"lineHeight":1.4,"color":"#7A8480","align":["left","top"]}},{"elementId":"prev-caption","elementType":"text","bounds":[462,336,442,18],"content":{"text":"左图：Claude Code 在 2026-11-10 为本介绍做的上一版，四页预览。","fontFamily":"Microsoft YaHei","fontSize":11,"lineHeight":1.4,"color":"#7A8480","align":["left","top"]}},{"elementId":"point","elementType":"text","bounds":[462,372,442,100],"content":{"text":"

这个项目要回答的问题：

让 AI 帮你做 slides 的同时，怎样保住你自己的重点和故事？

","fontFamily":"Microsoft YaHei","fontSize":16,"lineHeight":1.6,"color":"#3E4845","align":["left","top"]}},{"elementId":"ft-mark","elementType":"image","bounds":[56,505,16,16],"src":"media/.huandeng-versions/6b49274a35445235b8ab17f805b83cf3c7f8924630a5ce5ef8455e59aba5faef.png","sourceName":"huandeng.png","fit":{"mode":"contain"}},{"elementId":"ft-label","elementType":"text","bounds":[78,505,600,16],"content":{"text":"HUANDENG / 我为什么做幻灯","fontFamily":"Microsoft YaHei","fontSize":11,"lineHeight":1.3,"color":"#7A8480","align":["left","middle"]}},{"elementId":"ft-pos","elementType":"text","bounds":[824,505,80,16],"content":{"text":"0","fontFamily":"Microsoft YaHei","fontSize":11,"lineHeight":1.3,"color":"#7A8480","align":["right","middle"],"field":"main-position"}}] notes: "事情是从组会开始的。我在组会上看到越来越多用 AI 做的 slides，我也觉得这是趋势：slides 本身就是数据，是一种文件格式，agent 迟早要学会做它。但我的导师，还有屋里大多数人，一眼就能看出哪份是 AI 做的。每个工具风格不同，PowerPoint、Google Slides、ChatGPT、Kimi，可看起来都还是 AI。我在小红书上看到一个说法很认同：AI 味来自没有重点、面面俱到、没有故事、追求完整和免责。这是我个人的观察和判断，不是研究结论。连这份介绍也掉进过这个坑。右边是 Claude Code 前一天做的上一版，看着不错；我当时的评价是：美术效果很好，但没有重点，因为没有故事。这就是这个项目要解决的问题。"

designIntent.purpose: 动机一：组会上一眼能认出 AI 做的 slides；说明作者对 AI 味来源的理解，并以本介绍的上一版为例。
